scope: Exact selected fresh-body obstacle polygon transform semantics; source-bound static export, no engine actor/physics completeness claim.
evidence_kind: Matching-PDB procedure bounded LLVM disassembly, joined to retained original source hashes. No original code executed.

source_initialization.InitThing: Body.Scale multiplied by Thing.Scale unless MinScale/MaxScale request random value. Body.Angle AddAngle(Thing.StartAngle).
source_initialization.InitMapThing: Body.Scale multiplied by map.Scale; Body.Angle AddAngle(map.Angle*float32pi/180); Body.squashScale=map.SkewScale, squashAngle=map.SkewAngle*float32pi/180; map flips toggle fresh body bits.
source_initialization.generic_attachment_boundary: Static exporter uses original initial world XY. Native structural map obstacle parent links do not rebase it. Generic live AttachTo/animated parent transformations are separate and unsupported.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Prefer nonempty original map Points; otherwise nonempty resolved Thing.Points. Build canonical winding then offset by world XY.
native_polygon_setup_order.definition_helper: Polygon::Create RVA0x2da6a0 copies original definition points unchanged, normalizes winding, then offsets by supplied XY; SetupGeometry calls it with fourthargumentZ=0.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Directional squash/stretch around current location if Body.SquashStretchScale!=1.
native_polygon_setup_order.formula: e=(cos(skewAngle),-sin(skewAngle)); delta=(skewScale-1)*dot(p-origin,e)*e; p+=delta. Scalar f32 operations in observed order.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Uniform scale around current location by Body.Scale times current scale-transition value if active; fresh body scale transition inactive.
Optional ExtentScale>0 then RelativeExtentScale>0 adjustment. Both compiled/source0 for all exported room polygons; unsupported nonzero branch fails closed.
native_polygon_setup_order.field_correction: Native fields are ThingDataDef.ExtentScale and RelativeExtentScale, not guessed GeometryScale/GeometryScaleFraction.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Apply Body horizontal flip then vertical flip around current location, reversing point list after each reflection.
native_polygon_setup_order.MirrorGeometry: SetupGeometry does not consult Thing.MirrorGeometry: its recovered reflection branches directly test Body.mFlips bits1/2. No claim that MirrorGeometry is unused elsewhere.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Only when Thing.RotateGeometry true, rotate around current location by NEGATIVE Body.Angle.
native_polygon_setup_order.helper: Polygon::Rotate RVA0x1204b0 uses conventional x*cos-y*sin,x*sin+y*cos; callsite supplies -BodyAngle.
native_polygon_setup_order.default: RotateGeometry compiledfalse, so original map angle alone does not rotate collision.

native_polygon_setup_order.operation: Native recomputes polygon AABB and light-occluder/tallness/sort updates. Export retains only polygon points; broadphase manager integration is not claimed.

winding.behavior: Counts signs of successive edge cross products, +1 forpositive, -1 fornonpositive; return true iff signed vote negative. Fresh polygon reversed if false.
winding.actual_export: All207 polygons are convex, retain engine negative-turn winding after transforms.

player_hull.supported_initial_shape: Original octagon times Thing.Scale0.7, mapScale1, noflips/skew, RotateGeometrydefaultfalse. Original mapangle274 does not rotate hull. Nonempty Points branch wins over Size.
player_hull.boundary: Preserves currently reconstructed local player hull; does not prove original unit activation/controller or full collision response.

limits: Static transform semantics recovered; no original runtime polygon snapshot comparison or collision gameplay equivalence.
Float32 stage rounding reproduced; host/Windows CRT sinf/cosf last-bit equivalence not claimed.
No RNG value/seed/order fabricated; original random placements excluded even when mapAngle0.
Native fallback animation/size shapes, dynamic transitions, changing attachments, broadphase/narrowphase solver and runtime collision masks remain outside export.
Point packet IDs are original map metadata IDs, not asserted live obstacle handles or active actors.
